description: This file provides sanitization functions for user input, including filtering invisible characters, HTML tags, and code fence metadata, using the bluemonday library and custom logic.

methods.name: Sanitize
methods.description: Main function that sanitizes input by filtering invisible characters, code fence metadata, and HTML tags.

methods.name: FilterInvisibleCharacters
methods.description: Removes invisible or control Unicode characters from input string.

methods.name: FilterHTMLTags
methods.description: Sanitizes HTML tags in input string using bluemonday policy.

methods.name: FilterCodeFenceMetadata
methods.description: Removes hidden or suspicious info strings from fenced code blocks.

methods.name: sanitizeCodeFenceLine
methods.description: Processes a line to determine if it contains a code fence and sanitizes it accordingly.

methods.name: hasNonWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a string contains non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: isSafeCodeFenceToken
methods.description: Determines if a code fence info string contains only safe characters.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Initializes and returns a bluemonday sanitization policy with allowed elements and attributes.

methods.name: shouldRemoveRune
methods.description: Checks if a rune is an invisible or control character that should be removed.
